items.title: Germany and Italy warn against widening the Ukraine war
items.summary: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul reaffirmed Ukraine's right to self-defence but warned against geographically expanding the conflict. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni likewise said the war must not spread into the Mediterranean, following reported attacks on Russian vessels.

items.title: Ukrainian minister reportedly details wartime railway losses
items.summary: Ukraine's infrastructure minister Mykola Kalashnyk reportedly told parliament that 630 locomotives had been lost, nearly 400 during 2026, amid attacks on railway infrastructure. The figures have not been independently verified.

items.title: Libyan National Army reportedly threatens response to Benghazi attack
items.summary: Reports say Khalifa Haftar's Libyan National Army has threatened a military response to Ukraine following the reported attack on Benghazi port. No confirmed retaliatory action was reported.
